summary_1line: The gods grant the revived child Hanuman many boons, but mischievous behavior leads sages to curse him to forget his powers until reminded.

image_candidates.scene_text: Brahma gently touches the fallen child Hanuman in a dark cave while the gathered gods watch as the boy revives with radiant light.
The assembled gods each step forward to bless the young Hanuman as Vayu stands proudly beside his revived son.
Young Hanuman mischievously scatters sacred utensils and fires in a forest hermitage while astonished sages raise their hands to curse him.
